thread:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — we need to prioritize the compliance sprint. Customers are asking for: longer audit retention, BYOK handshake improvements, and an evidence export SLA. How do we rank these against SOC2 readiness work?
Sam (Eng): Agree need prioritization. My initial read: BYOK handshake has high implementation cost. Retention is mostly storage + infra. Evidence-export SLA touches platform + ops.
Devon (Security): From risk perspective: SOC2 gaps are high-impact for enterprise deals. Audit retention length is negotiable with customers; but immutability/chain-of-custody concerns (integrity) are non-negotiable.
Maria (Legal): Legal hold + e-discovery requirements push some customers to want export guarantees within X hours. Also BYOK contract language needs escrow/rotation clauses.
Anya (PM): Proposed scoring: Impact (customer revenue/risk) 1-5, Effort 1-5, Operational complexity 1-5. Prioritize by Impact/(Effort+Complexity). Thoughts?
Sam (Eng): Fine. Quick scores: BYOK handshake Impact=4 Effort=5 Complexity=4. Retention (12/24/36mo options): Impact=3 Effort=2 Complexity=2. Evidence-export SLA (24/72h): Impact=4 Effort=3 Complexity=3. SOC2 gap fixes: Impact=5 Effort=4 Complexity=3.
Devon (Security): Add a separate weight for "regulatory blockers" where anything that prevents sales into finserv is bumped up. SOC2 + keystore assurances should get that bump.
Maria (Legal): FYI: Finserv pilot requires both SOC2 and a BYOK option with rotation/escrow text. If we want that revenue, we must deliver both within timeline.
Anya (PM): Using Sam's numbers and bump for regulatory blockers, top two are SOC2 fixes and BYOK handshake. Evidence-export SLA and extended retention follow.
Sam (Eng): Implementation note: we can break BYOK into phases — (A) BYOK basic handshake + upload (no escrow) (B) escrow/rotation + audit APIs. Phase A is 3 sprints; Phase B is 4 sprints.
Devon (Security): For retention, propose a tiered model: default 12mo, enterprise 36mo (paid). That reduces engineering lift and aligns with storage costs. Also add tamper-evidence metadata (Merkle root) rather than full append-only retrofitting.
Maria (Legal): Tiered model OK. Need contract addendum templates for retention tiers and legal hold escape hatches. I can draft templates once we pick tiers.
Anya (PM): Proposed launch criteria for MVP (phase A): 1) BYOK handshake upload + basic rotation docs, 2) SOC2 critical-gap fixes (list attached), 3) Evidence-export: deliver CSV + structured export within 72h SLA for pilot, 4) Retention tier UI toggles. Accept if ops load < 2x baseline.
Sam (Eng): Ops load check — we should add a canary on export path and rate-limit exports per-tenant. ops-bot: export-job-queue depth alert set to 50 -> ok?
ops-bot: noted — export-job-queue alert threshold set to 50 for this thread.
Devon (Security): Risk mitigations: require customer acknowledgement for BYOK phase A (we document limitations), and always default to encrypted-at-rest with our keys if handshake fails. Add telemetry to flag failed handshakes.
Anya (PM): Action items: Sam scope phase A BYOK + retention UI tickets by EOW; Devon to enumerate SOC2 critical-gap list by Wednesday; Maria to prepare contract addenda draft by Friday. We'll reconvene Thu to lock prioritization and see if we can pull one extra sprint.
Sam (Eng): Will post PRD with technical tradeoffs and rough cost estimates later today.
Maria (Legal): Will include sample legal-hold language and escrow outline.
Devon (Security): I'll attach the risk-scoring sheet and finserv blockers.
Anya (PM): Thanks — good direction. If anyone has urgent customer asks that change scoring ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): +1
Devon (Security): +1
Maria (Legal): +1
